title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Recording a Further Term at the Price Settled for It
content:
## Contract administration desk entry

Where a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record is to run on for a further term, that term is recorded against the agreement at the price settled for it. A further term is recorded only once the agreement stands back in force after a withdrawal of coverage.

### What the entry does

The agreement rolls into a further term of the same length as the one just ending: the new term starts the day after the current term's last day and runs for the same number of days, the annual price in force is replaced by the price given, and the agreement's standing moves back to active for the new term. Afterwards the owner sees the new term dates and the new annual price on the agreement, and coverage runs on without a break.

### How it is recorded

The desk unlocks the agent-side tool `renew_agreement_term_748887d3` and calls it. One call rolls the named agreement into the further term.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | the reference number of the preventive maintenance agreement record rolled into a further term | an identifier, read from the maintenance agreement lookup before the call |
| `renewed_annual_price_usd` | the annual price in force for the further term | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the cent; an amount of zero is accepted and records a zero price |

### Return

The call returns a one-line confirmation naming the agreement rolled over, the first and last day of the further term as YYYY-MM-DD, the annual price now in force in USD to two decimal places and the standing the agreement now carries. That line is issued only when the term dates, the price and the standing have all been written; it is the receipt of completion.
